review: author-context self-review; no independent or external model call
omissions: Responses omit guidance text, assignments, local paths and detailed checks; an unchanged repeated prompt request is omitted. Inputs are complete.

brief.question: What can the supplied shipment note establish about Company A?
brief.audience: An operations colleague reading a workflow example.
brief.scope: Fictional Company A in 2026; only the supplied source note.
brief.output: Three short English paragraphs in final.md with a readable source link.
brief.depth: Separate the reported count, the unsupported revenue inference, and the next evidence needed.
brief.evidence_standard: Read the supplied fictional note; disclose that it is not market evidence and that review is self only.

requirements.location: final.md, paragraphs 1-3; state/task_spec.md, output and depth
requirements.basis: The three paragraphs answer the reported count, why revenue is unsupported, and the records needed next. The readable source link and fictional/self-review disclosures match the brief.

evidence.basis: The supplied note explicitly reports twelve shipments in 2026 and supplies no revenue, price, returns or payment data. The report attributes the count to the fictional note instead of asserting a real-world fact.

adversarial_reasoning.basis: An assumed unit price cannot establish revenue; the report rejects that inference. No business performance conclusion is drawn from the shipment count.

structure_and_depth.basis: The narrow assignment needs a reported observation, an inference boundary and a next step. The paragraphs provide these without claiming a broader company assessment.

reader_usefulness.basis: The title identifies the question and the ending specifies the missing records before a revenue estimate. This is actionable within the fictional example scope.

process_language.basis: The invented-source and self-review notices are limitations explicitly required by the brief. There are no internal claim IDs, execution logs or production narration in the prose.

natural_expression.basis: Each paragraph has a distinct purpose and names the evidence or missing input directly. No repeated conclusion, unexplained acronym or unsupported adjective needs correction.

arguments.message: The fictional shipment note is complete, with self-review only and no independent review.
